concepts.title: Ratios and Percentages
concepts.formula: percentage = (part / whole) x 100; ratio a : b = a / b

questions.q: Find 40% of 80.

concepts.title: Finding Values from Percentages (Unitary Method)
concepts.formula: total = value x 100 / percent; part of value = percent x value / 100

concepts.formula: discount = marked_price - sale_price; discount percent = discount x 100 / marked_price

concepts.formula: discount = marked_price x discount_percent / 100; sale_price = marked_price x (100 - discount_percent) / 100

concepts.formula: tax = price x tax_percent / 100; bill_amount = price + tax; original_price = final_price x 100 / (100 + tax_percent)

concepts.formula: SI = principal x rate x time / 100; amount = principal + interest
